findings.current: the keen, ice-cold blade that would isolate Ares Guild from the entire world
findings.defect: The source describes a 시퍼런 칼날—a vividly gleaming, blue blade. “Ice-cold” adds a temperature image, while the English loses the source’s visual detail.
findings.rationale: The Korean adjective 시퍼런 supplies the blade’s vivid color/gleam, not coldness.
findings.replacement: the gleaming blue blade that would isolate Ares Guild from the entire world

summary: One minor source-image shift: the blade’s vivid blue gleam becomes an unsupported coldness.
